name: Video Template Extract (YouTube URL -> Gemini, fallback to yt-dlp transcript + Claude -> flowchart/checklist)

parameters.jsonBody: ={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":{{ JSON.stringify("You are watching a tutorial video and extracting its real step-by-step process as a flowchart for an internal reference library. Watch the actual video content - narration, on-screen actions, and any text or UI shown - not just the title or description. Capture the process as it is actually demonstrated, including any decision points, for example if X do Y otherwise do Z, as diamond-shaped nodes. Keep node labels short, a few words each. Output strict Mermaid flowchart TD syntax as a single string, with each statement on its own line, no styling directives, no markdown code fences inside the mermaid value itself. Every node label must be wrapped in double quote characters immediately inside its brackets or braces, since unquoted parentheses, colons, or commas inside a label will break the Mermaid parser. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no commentary, with exactly these keys: title, a short 3 to 6 word title for this process; summary, a 1 to 2 sentence summary of what this tutorial accomplishes; mermaid, the full flowchart TD diagram as a single string.") }}},{"fileData":{"fileUri":{{ JSON.stringify($json.youtube_url) }},"mimeType":"video/*"}}]}]}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":{{ JSON.stringify("You are watching a tutorial or process video and extracting it as an ordered, actionable checklist for an internal reference library. The output will become an editable spreadsheet or slide deck that a person fills in or works through by hand. Watch the actual video content - narration, on-screen actions, and any text or UI shown - not just the title or description. Each checklist item must be a single, concrete, actionable task, not a vague summary of a whole section. Order items exactly as they occur in the video. Keep step short, a few words, and put specifics, values, or caveats in detail. Aim for 5 to 20 items; merge trivial sub-actions into their parent step rather than producing dozens of tiny items. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no commentary, with exactly these keys: title, a short 3 to 6 word title for this checklist; summary, a 1 to 2 sentence summary of what completing this checklist achieves; checklist, an array of objects each with a step key and a detail key.") }}},{"fileData":{"fileUri":{{ JSON.stringify($json.youtube_url) }},"mimeType":"video/*"}}]}]}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: $json.status === 'ready', id: $json.id, mode: $json.mode, title: $json.title, summary: $json.ai_summary, mermaid: $json.mermaid_code, checklist: $json.checklist_json, status: $json.status, error: $json.error_message }) }}
